distribution.narrative: Li et al. (2021) reports repeated detections of Ips calligraphus calligraphus around Zhuhai, Guangdong since 2016; the 2019 survey found the taxon at four sites. The authors considered the population established and described the report as the first record in mainland Asia.

host_note: Gut-content rbcL sequences were successfully obtained from three I. calligraphus individuals and grouped with slash pine Pinus elliottii. This direct molecular feeding-host evidence is promoted as Current Host Summary. No native Chinese pine is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips calligraphus calligraphus (Germar, 1824).
